parameters.jsCode:
const x = $input.first().json;

const store = $getWorkflowStaticData('global');
const used = Array.isArray(store.published)
  ? store.published.slice(-35)
  : [];

const prompt = `
You are an expert viral Shorts analyst and cinematic film director.

Create ONE original, visually spectacular, continuous 20-second story from recent social media trend METADATA.

The final film consists of FOUR consecutive 5-second clips.

CRITICAL: VISUAL CONTINUITY
- Choose ONE clearly identifiable main subject.
- Choose ONE fixed environment.
- Choose ONE consistent visual style.
- All four scenes must feel like ONE uninterrupted recording.
- Repeat the SAME detailed description of the subject, colors, materials, location and lighting in EVERY scene prompt.
- Do not introduce unrelated subjects, locations or objects.
- Do not transform the subject into something unrelated.
- No sudden changes of time, weather, camera position or visual style.
- Every new scene starts at the EXACT moment the previous scene ends.
- Scenes 2, 3 and 4 will receive the PREVIOUS VIDEO'S LAST FRAME as their starting image.
- Describe motion that naturally continues from that starting frame.
- Camera movements must be physically continuous.

STORY STRUCTURE:
Scene 1 (0-5s): Powerful visual hook. Establish the subject and environment.
Scene 2 (5-10s): Continue the SAME subject and action. Increase curiosity.
Scene 3 (10-15s): Deliver a surprising development WITHOUT changing the location or subject.
Scene 4 (15-20s): Satisfying payoff and visually memorable ending.

VIDEO RULES:
- 9:16 vertical cinematic AI video.
- Four detailed English prompts, each 80-120 words.
- Realistic lighting, textures and movement.
- No dialogue, subtitles, logos or visible text.
- No copyrighted characters or famous people.
- No reused footage.
- Each scene must describe ONLY its own 5 seconds.
- Prioritize continuity over random spectacular changes.

Analyze these real trend candidates, using only their metadata.
Do not pretend to have watched their videos.
Do not invent statistics or source URLs.

OUTPUT:
Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these keys:

{
  "concept": "English concept title",
  "category": "visual category",
  "why": "Brief explanation of trend evidence and uncertainty",
  "selectedSourceUrl": "An exact URL from candidates",
  "sourceUrls": ["Up to 3 exact URLs from candidates"],
  "scenePrompts": [
    "Detailed Scene 1 prompt",
    "Detailed Scene 2 prompt",
    "Detailed Scene 3 prompt",
    "Detailed Scene 4 prompt"
  ],
  "youtubeTitle": "Catchy English title #shorts",
  "youtubeDescription": "Brief description disclosing AI-generated visuals",
  "hashtags": ["ai", "cinematic", "shorts"]
}

Ensure ALL four scenePrompts repeat the SAME subject identity, setting, materials and lighting.

Avoid repeating previously published concepts:
${JSON.stringify(used.map(v => v.concept))}

Source health:
${JSON.stringify(x.platforms)}

Recent trend candidates:
${JSON.stringify((x.candidates || []).slice(0, 24))}
`;

return [{
  json: {
    body: {
      contents: [{
        role: "user",
        parts: [{ text: prompt }]
      }],
      generationConfig: {
        responseMimeType: "application/json",
        maxOutputTokens: 3900
      }
    }
  }
}];
